Facts and calculations:

- Lindenmoor: 2,151,400 cubic metres of water and 29,051 residents.
- Kelmarsh: 1,739 megalitres = 1,739,000 cubic metres, with 24,117 residents.
- One cubic metre equals 1,000 litres; 2025 has 365 days.
- Lindenmoor: \(2,151,400 \times 1,000 \div 29,051 \div 365 = 202.9\) litres per resident per day.
- Kelmarsh: \(1,739,000 \times 1,000 \div 24,117 \div 365 = 197.6\) litres per resident per day.
- Difference: \(202.9 - 197.6 = 5.3\) litres per resident per day.

ANSWER: Lindenmoor | 5.3
